title: Polish Grape Leaves Dumplings
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring grape leaves and vegetarian-friendly ingredients, perfect for a brunch mood, lightly steamed to preserve the delicate flavors and textures of the grape leaves and filling.
instructions: Rinse the grape leaves and remove the stems, then set them aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mushrooms and sauerkraut to the skillet and cook until the mushrooms release their moisture and start to brown.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked mushroom mixture, vegetable broth, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
To assemble the dumplings, lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface, with the stem end facing you, and place a tablespoon of the filling in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package, repeating with the remaining grape leaves and filling.

Place the dumplings in a steamer basket, leaving space between each dumpling to allow for even cooking, and steam over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until the grape leaves are tender and the filling is heated through.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
